values.note: Accessible double vault toilet, covered pavilion with picnic tables, group grill and fire pits, accessible fishing platform. Pack in, pack out (a few city-maintained garbage bins, no dumpsters). A camp host may be present.

facilities.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/matthews-recreation-area-srma ('Running water is not available.', 'It is near the accessible double vault toilet.', 'Facilities: restrooms, picnic tables, fire pits, standing grills, covered picnic area ... handicap accessible fishing platform', 'A camp host may be present on-site.'; descriptions uploaded October 2024), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No numbered sites: 'Primitive, non-dispersed camping is available - primarily in the parking areas and near the restroom.' The first lot (off Tusler Rd, partly paved) holds '2 campers'; the southern hard-packed lot 'several campers'.

note: BLM Special Recreation Management Area ~9 mi NE of Miles City on the south side of the Yellowstone River (Valley Drive East, then Tusler Rd across the railroad tracks; gravel access). Primitive dirt put-in for rafts, no improved boat launch. No fireworks. --Claude
summary: BLM page (Miles City Field Office, last described October 2024): confirmed free camping ('No Fee.'), vault toilet, no running water; added that camping is in the two parking areas (2 campers / several campers). Not stated: a stay limit (derived 16 days left), FCFS wording (derived 'always' left; no reservation system mentioned), season. Phone 406-233-2800 matches the page's event-scheduling number. flags: Criteria question: BLM describes this as a day-use/picnic site where 'Overnight camping is permitted' and camping is 'primarily in the parking areas and near the restroom' (one lot holds '2 campers', the other 'several campers'); no designated campsites. A 23-ft rig fits a parking lot, but it is parking-lot camping rather than a campground.
